global_backend.description: Database engine backend type. Use 'external' for external database server.

global_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections (0 = unlimited).

global_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format) for secure server connections.

global_ssl_private_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format) corresponding to the certificate.

global_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying client certificates (optional).

global_use_ssl.description: Whether to require SSL/TLS for external connections.

global_cluster_id.description: Cluster identifier used for multi-cluster deployments. Should be unique per logical cluster.

ic_site_id.description: Unique identifier for this site/cluster in the interconnection.

ic_peers.description: List of peer sites to interconnect with. Each peer requires a connection URL and optional SSL settings.

site_id.description: Unique ID of the peer site (must match that site's site_id).

url.description: Connection URL for the peer OVN IC DB (e.g., 'tcp:192.168.10.2:6643' or 'ssl:192.168.10.2:6643').

ssl_cert.description: Peer-specific SSL client certificate for mutual authentication (optional).

ssl_private_key.description: Peer-specific SSL client private key (must accompany ssl_cert).

ssl_ca_cert.description: Peer-specific CA certificate for verifying peer server cert.

ic_peer_health_check_interval.description: Seconds between health check requests to peers.

ic_peer_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for peer response before marking it as unhealthy.

ic_verbose.description: Enable detailed logging of interconnection operations (for troubleshooting).

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs go to stderr only.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Options: info, notice, warning, err, critical, emerg, debug.

log_syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog (e.g., daemon, local0, local1).

audit_enable.description: Enable audit logging (tracks database mutations and administrative actions).

audit_file.description: Path for the audit log file (ignored if audit logging is disabled).

audit_level.description: Audit log verbosity (usually info or notice).
